_meta.com.requstory/summary: One supplier's dated trade facts, its record with buyers and recent prices.

description: One supplier in the Requstory Index by its website domain: every dated trade fact (prices or quote on request, minimum order, payment terms, delivery, returns, trade account), whether the owner verified the listing, its record with real buyer requests (answered, usual hours to answer, orders that arrived) and prices read on its site or quoted in the last 60 days. Use after search_suppliers, before request_quote.

supplier.description: The "supplier" value from search_suppliers (the supplier's website domain), e.g. "ukpackaging.com".
